text:
ops-oncall: :rotating_light: eu-central-1 GPUs degraded — autoscaler up but pods in Pending, a lot of OOMs on inference nodes. Noticed missing gpu_util_pct and node_net_bytes metrics in Grafana around 01:12 UTC.
maya: seeing it too. control-plane healthy, but kubelet logs show repeated `failed to register device plugin` on a subset of nodes.
sahil: linking the alert: https://grafana.internal/redwood/alerts/1234 — alert shows pod scheduling latency spike and no GPU utilization series.
joanne: is this the same issue from last month where the device-plugin crashed after kernel update?
noah: checking kernel package changes in the region, there was a node image rollout 00:40 UTC — but autoscaler kickstarted replacements at 00:55.
ops-oncall: quick mitigation: shifting traffic off eu-central-1 for ephemeral workloads. Can we route hosted inference to eu-west-1 for 30m?
maya: runbook step 3: set `traffic-weight` to 0 for eu-central in global-router config. Example: `rdctl routing set-weight --region eu-central-1 --weight 0`
sahil: did that, confirmed with `rdctl routing get` — weighted routes now eu-west 100%. :white_check_mark:
joanne: but Dedicated customers in eu-central will still need capacity. Are Dedicated pools affected?
ops-oncall: Dedicated pools on eu-central showing `node-exporter` missing on 6 nodes — that's why gpu metrics vanish. We should cordon the affected nodes and drain if they fail device plugin.
noah: `kubectl get nodes -l region=eu-central -o wide` shows 6 nodes in NotReady with taint `plugin-failed=true`.
maya: draining now: `kubectl drain ip-10-0-3-27 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — a couple pods rescheduled to eu-west and pending due to placement constraints.
observability-bot: Missing metric families: `gpu_util_pct`, `gpu_temp_c`, `node_network_receive_bytes_total` between 01:12:00 and 01:22:00 UTC.
sahil: patch quick-find: device-plugin container crashed due to permission error hitting /dev/nvidiactl after kubelet restarted. Logs: ```time="01:11:54" level=error msg="open /dev/nvidiactl: permission denied"```
joanne: looks like the node image rollout reverted seccomp profile and removed privileged bit on plugin DaemonSet in the image config. Ops change slipped through image promotion.
ops-oncall: short term: restart device-plugin as privileged on affected nodes: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart ds/gpu-device-plugin` after adding `securityContext: { privileged: true }` patch. Do we have approval?
maya: rolling restart applied to DS, but since kubelet refused plugin registration, need node reboot to clear stale device state for some. Scheduling reboots now in small batches.
noah: agreed, reboots queued with stagger 30s to avoid mass reattach storms.
sahil: instrumentation gap note: GPU exporter loses all series if node-exporter (kube-state relabel) fails. We had no per-pod fallback; dashboards assume node metrics always present. Need to add `gpu_pod_utilization` coming from sidecar on each inference pod so we still see GPU usage while node exporter is down.
joanne: filing a remediation ticket and PR: add sidecar exporter + a Grafana panel fallback to service-level aggregates. Also add alert rule: `absent_over_time(gpu_util_pct[5m]) and up{job="kubelet"} == 1` to detect missing series when nodes are healthy.
ops-oncall: temporary mitigation done, traffic shifted, reboots in progress. ETA for normal routing back: 02:15 UTC if reboots stable.
maya: note for post-incident: missing kubelet logs retention in eu-central — two of the kubelet crash logs were truncated. We should increase retention to 14 days for node logs in that region.
sahil: cost note: shifting heavy traffic to eu-west will bump egress and GPU-hour spend ~+18% for next 3h. Finance pinged.
noah: followups: create perf synthetic canary that runs small infer request every 1m per region and validates `gpu_util_pct` series presence; PR drafted: https://git.redwood/pull/4987
joanne: also need to prevent image promotion pipeline from altering DS securityContext; add an integration test to smoke restart DaemonSets after promotion.
ops-oncall: final status: device-plugin fixed by privileged DS restart + node reboots; node-exporter restored; metrics back by 01:58 UTC; routing returned to normal at 02:10 UTC. Marking incident as mitigated. :white_check_mark:
maya: opened follow-up issues: OBS-231 (sidecar exporter), OBS-232 (kubelet retention), OPS-443 (promotion gating).
sahil: thanks everyone. We'll run a short RCA tomorrow. :coffee:
observability-bot: Incident timeline summarized and exported to /incidents/1761289472-summary.txt
